profile.headline: Software Engineer Staff at Lockheed Martin
profile.summary:
•	Has more than 22 years of successful experience in Information Technology industry,  with experiences encompassing software engineering, architecture, object-oriented design and development, J2EE related/SOA/XML technologies, Oracle, UNIX shell scripting, and the Army’s Global Command and Control System.
•	Acquired in-depth knowledge of full life cycle development, including migration, COTS/GOTS integration, and deployment of applications on Solaris platforms.
•	Attained excellent problem solving, evaluative and communication skills.  Provided technical support to fielded software at various military installations around the world via help ticket, email, and telephone.  
•	Good organizational, interpersonal skills and the ability to learn quickly.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Develop web applications, utilizing Ruby on Rails framework.

positions.title: Software Engineer Staff
positions.description:
• Developed software for Defense Readiness Reporting System - Army (DRRS-A) utilizing JSP, XML, Spring, Apache Camel, and Hibernate.
• A subject matter expert to team in migrating legacy software to a web service application, utilizing XML, HTTP, SOAP, Apache ServiceMix Enterprise Service Bus with Apache Camel, Spring framework, third-party APIs. 
• Modify software resulting from requirement changes, defects, and enhancements to fielded software.
• Provide support for external integration and test activities to demonstrate interoperability with Joint and other Army Battle Command Systems.
• Integrate software on Solaris 10 servers and ensuring that software interfaces with external systems.

positions.title: Systems Engineer
positions.description:
• A team lead for External Transaction Manager (ETM) Computer Software Component Item.  Managed team of five developers.
• Migrated C/C++/Esqlc code to Java.  
• Designed and code to software requirements and created models using Rational Rose.  
• Arranged and tested ETM to interface with Integrated C4I System Framework (ICSF) Common Operating Picture (COP) and Joint Common Database. 
• Developed software to interface with the Army Battle Command System Publisher and Subscriber Service (PASS) for exchanging of XML-formatted messages between the Army and Joint Forces.  Utilized the Simple Object Access Protocol (SOAP) to publish and subscribe unit and platform data contained in XML messages to and from the PASS server.
• Migrated ETM software to interface with Oracle vice Informix
• Performed full-cycle development of the External Transaction Manager (ETM) Service application to interface with external systems for sending/receiving and extracting of United States Message Text Format and OTH-GOLD messages.  
• Designed, developed and tested ETM to interface with external systems using C++, C, ESQL/C, UNIX shell scripts, and PowerBuilder development tool.
• Developed and tested new database backup/restore utility and database migration utility using UNIX shell scripts and C language for the LAN Administrator Utilities.
• Provided capabilities for forwarding of email and sending of files between the Standard Theater Army Command and Control System (STACCS) legacy HP-UX system and the Army Global Command and Control System (AGCCS) Solaris system as part of the data synchronization effort, which was deployed at USAREUR, Germany.
